items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 11:42pm
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W 4 or 5, backing SW 3 or 4. Then backing S 4 or 5 later, then increasing 5 or 6 overnight, then 6 or 7 near end of period.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming moderate later, perhaps rough near end of period.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C

##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain or drizzle becoming isolated later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor at first.

16°C
